decision_scope: Approve only the existing frozen Stage1 development evaluation on the previously opened Stage0 SCORE data. Root separately binds the actual release after its dependency/source checks. TEST remains unopened; no new round or scientific outcome is assigned.
learning_and_scope: All 32 main endpoint/operator N80-to-N120 VALID curves improve; this does not establish convergence. N80 supervised fits/bases follow their own data and frozen hyperparameters under the approved source.

The q128 FP32 G/PE points are worse than local on mixed VALID; q512 W8 host points approach local while still trading error for storage and host work. These development values are neither phase-specific decode quality nor confirmatory signs.

The q512 actual-span diagnostics leave substantial room below the linear-latent errors. Failure of these fixed estimators would not eliminate stronger latent functions, other U, or all low-rank models; the truncated-span and finite-rounding caveats remain.

The resource ledger is analytic extrapolation only: inclusive host residency, KV/workspace, actual CPU/cache, PE throughput, FIFO/input ABI, collisions and shared-branch overlap remain unresolved. Zero NAND traffic is not zero latency.
Preserve all 560 comparisons and both phases. The same sparse natural routes and frozen bootstrap rule can again make the complete family undefined; do not filter or redraw to rescue a subset.
Original Stage0 remains inconclusive. Reuse of its SCORE is explicitly development/exploratory, and cannot automatically increment the Round2 failure count or establish publication success.
